title: Aoyagi Toya — My Shackles Are The Key〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Interesting. Going over how counterpoints work again was a good idea. I might be able to put them to use in my song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? It's three in the morning?
I seem to have lost track of time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That explains why I'm starting to feel sleepy... But I don't have time for that right now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll go pour myself some coffee...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Aha, I knew it. You're still up.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Oh, Miku, it's you...
What brings you here so late?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was just patrolling around.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Patrolling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. I heard that you've been tasked with writing all of your team's songs for surpassing RAD WEEKEND.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, I came to see if you weren't pushing yourself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But I guess you were...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I was just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, you're right...
I'm up this late, so it's only natural for you to think that I'm burning the candle at both ends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for making you worry. I promise to be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, as long as you understand.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <By the way, what's this book you were reading just now...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I borrowed it from my dad's study.
I was hoping that it'd contain some helpful information.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's your dad's?
It looks old, but pristine at the same time.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It is.
He likes to take good care of his books.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember reading many during our lessons together when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
It's nothing that important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was just reminded of how I accidentally damaged one of his books...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Still, I'm having a hard time imagining you doing that. What happened that time, Toya?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After practices, I always made sure to stay in my dad's study whenever I decided to read one of his books...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because I wanted to learn to do what he could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, one day, I took a book into the living room and ended up falling asleep on top of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, a few pages got creased...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, I'd be scared too...
I mean, I can see your dad getting really mad.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can't think of any other time in my life when I panicked so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But then, my mom came along and said...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you fell asleep on top of it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: But you were just trying to do your best to learn as much as you can about classical music, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure your father will understand since you're looking for ways to become a better musician...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: So, let's go apologize to him together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Your mom's so nice.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she made me feel a lot better that time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We went over to my dad's study together afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, what happened...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I showed my dad the book, he immediately saw the creased pages...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still remember vividly the way he moved his finger along the folds...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He didn't scold me in any way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said, “Take good care of any books you read.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“That being said, it's good that you're so studious. Just be careful next time.”
...is what he told me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Both your mom and dad noticed how hard you were trying.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. As hard as those lessons were, they always watched over me with a warm gaze.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite all the affection they showed me, I ended up disappointing them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
Now's not the time to be reminiscing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I have work to do.
I need to focus on that..)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for stopping by, Miku.
It was nice having someone to talk to like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm going to keep working for a little while longer. I need this song to be extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Then, I'll head back now.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But don't forget that we're watching over you too, Toya, so feel free to ask if you ever need any help.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, good night.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. Good night.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Back then and even now, I have people watching over me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which is why I need to succeed this time.
I'm not going to disappoint anyone.
